statement: Every asynchronous replica completion, rollback and cleanup continuation acts only on the exact operation, entity incarnation and owner generation whose authority it retained. A successor generation cannot be settled or undone by an older continuation; current canonical completion still makes useful progress and releases only its own resources.

constraints.statement: Initial completion: 0.4.1 bounded correction under operation-integrity-and-reliable-formation. This is an unsealed proposal, not executed acceptance. Reconcile main ef93af85dcd6add82ff5b5fee21ca12d205c61cd with preserved WIP dc29d85bedbbe4310bfcd4cf7e46e8b65a654b2d before implementation; preserve historical seals and failed evidence. Use existing proof owners to obtain a genuine discriminating red before start, independently reviewed source and lab-executed proof on the actual interaction, including useful progress and resource release. A refuted source hypothesis must have a recorded counterexample disposition, not an invented fix or passing boolean.

Continue the asynchronous settlement gap beyond solved canonical-replica-completion-observation and cache-replica-incarnation-coherence. Use the replica operation repository, canonical completion owner and actual lifecycle mutation/cleanup consumers. Do not add a competing completion predicate or replace current owner state with cached observations.

Suspend at each await between authoritative observation and durable mutation, replace or retire the operation/replica generation, then resume old success, error, rollback and finally paths. Refence at the actual write or compare-and-set boundary against the canonical owner, not only at initial dispatch. Include leader/owner change and lost completion reply. Include same-status ABA and legitimate retry of the unchanged generation. A membership relay is only a wake: it may trigger a fresh owner read without being promoted to an authoritative observation certificate.

Capture identities needed to retire the original operation and its resources; delayed cleanup must not look up a successor by an unversioned key and delete or close it. Record distinct decision, visible publication and physical release outcomes. A failed release retains its obligation and canonical recovery wake.

Pair stale-generation refusal with a finite current-generation completion and recovery witness through production owners. Preserve existing readiness, committed CREATE cohort and formation timing predicates. If current source already fences a proposed schedule, retain the refutation and test the remaining actual consumer closure rather than changing working semantics.

The WIP-only src/node/replica-removal-settlement.js settleRemovedOutsideRemoval captures runtime/service identity before awaiting membership, while subscribeRemovalSettlement queues by replicaId. Main and WIP src/node/replica-handler-status-methods.js updateReplicaStatus and its retry/rollback paths also require exact-generation review. Reconcile these sources at composition; do not claim the WIP-only module is already on main. The open message-group-fresh-identity-membership Quest retains the SERVICES generation/CAS and cleanup implementation authority. Preserve its separation of terminal decision, membership effect and physical release.
